headline: Elkhorn house done, cattle buying sent east
summary: Roosevelt dispatches Merrifield, Sewall and Dow to Minnesota with a $12,500 check to buy about 1,000 more cattle. Alone, he takes three trips to explore the country, and at the Mingusville hotel he turns away a drunk cowboy, warning he will shoot anyone who forces his door. Sewall and Dow finish the Elkhorn ranch house.

events.detail: Sends Merrifield, Sewall and Dow to Minnesota to buy roughly 1,000 head with a $12,500 check
Makes three solitary rides to see more of the country
At a Mingusville hotel, bars a drunken cowboy from his room and threatens to fire on intruders; the man leaves
Sewall and Dow complete the eight-room Elkhorn house, 60 by 30 feet, with a cellar and a darkroom
His investments total $130,000: $85,000 in Dakota and $45,000 in Leeholm

uncertain: Entry gathers several undated spring events; the Mingusville hotel is described as the one where TR had knocked out a drunken cowboy the previous year.
